entry.description: 1. Adds back the LoggerConfig constructor used by Spring Boot. 2. Fix LoggerUpdaterTest: * testUpdateLoggersPropertyListeners: it now keeps a reference to its configuration-started listener and removes it in a finally block. * propertyChangeListenerReceivesOldAndNewConfigurationOnReconfiguration: in a finally block, it now removes its property-change listener and calls context.reconfigure().
